tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Use first if you're unsure whether a country is covered: lists every country with data, its currency, which kinds of calculator it has (income tax/PAYE, mobile money, bank fees, loans, savings, SACCO dividends) and which central bank indicators exist. Takes no inputs.

tools.name: get_take_home_pay

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Use to find a calculator's slug before get_calculator_rules or run_calculator: lists calculators with open rules (PAYE, mobile money tariffs, bank fees, loans, savings, SACCO dividends), optionally filtered by country and type. To see which countries are covered at all, use list_countries.

tools.name: search_kenya_car_crsp
tools.description: Use for Kenyan car import and valuation questions: looks up KRA's Current Retail Selling Price (CRSP), the value Kenya's import duty is calculated from, by make and/or model, e.g. "toyota vitz", "prado", "nissan note". Kenya only: other countries have no CRSP data here.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_country_overview" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use when the user asks about a country in general or you need context before answering: one call returns the country's central bank rate and inflation, how PAYE…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
